profiles.why: They raise half the pot with any cards. Showdown quality, not the raise itself, decides whether a call tightens or loosens.

profiles.why: They pot it with any cards. The live showdown read decides the call, because a stored tighten would fold hands that beat their air.
profiles.label: Official practice bot: baseline_always_pot

facts: choose_action returns RAISE_POT when legal, otherwise CHECK_CALL.
